small_components.writes: P04 BOX inbound/P19 issue retain all owner guards, draft/version/receipt and posting
small_components.issue_eligibility: Re-resolve through P19; GET classification does not grant case/session/warehouse/stock/write eligibility

errors.503: Source/single-warehouse scope unavailable, no fake empty data
